output.headline: Health IT strategics and platform-backed sponsors form the buyer universe for this national target; median pricing at 21.4x EV/EBITDA is defensible.
sentences: Call Evolent Health first, with 3 deals in the sub-sector and a closed $325M; the order among sponsors such as Blackstone is close to a tie, with back-tests at 28% against 20% random [E:tier1, E:sponsor_ordering].

A median multiple of 21.4x EV/EBITDA is defensible because the 25.0% margin is above the comparable median but not top quarter; Evolent Health, Blackstone, Francisco Partners and Epic Systems can pay it comfortably [E:valuation, E:tier1].
The review removed Ciox Health and Cerner (Oracle) because they now sit inside Datavant and Oracle, and merged Change Healthcare into UnitedHealth Group [E:review].
Most buyers share diversification and technology capability as a motive, seen in 100% of 50 Health IT deals, so frame the pitch around it [E:motives].
